scope: Server tests only; no native client run or production mutation
database: Dedicated local PostgreSQL with isolated schemas

assertions: Expired access tokens renew through OAuth refresh without a new login
Rotated access tokens and replayed refresh tokens are rejected
Concurrent refresh accepts exactly one use
Attribution and canonical audit session survive token rotation
Credential revocation rejects subsequent calls on an initialized MCP session
Removed membership and deactivated identity reject MCP calls and refresh
Revoking one credential session does not revoke another login
A new authorized grant uses the selected workspace and actor
Forged workspace and identity headers cannot change token authority
An unmapped workspace cannot issue a grant
Pending approval prevents mutation and retry does not create duplicate requests
A peer's HTTP approval permits the same protected fixture action on retry
Rejection and timeout leave fixture state unchanged
Cross-workspace reads and decisions are rejected
Late or repeated decisions are rejected
fixtures: Policy input and external IdP verifier
Explicit approver identity and role dependency overrides
Notification delivery and audit hash helpers
application_code: Persisted approval request and timeout sweep
HTTP decision endpoint and peer self-approval checks
OAuth credential validation and MCP transport
